Hi Aisha,

We're trying to finish vendor setup for EuroLogistics with Redwood so we can get the new routing and tracking integration live. Procurement here needs clarity on two items before we issue the first invoice:

1) Which Redwood legal entity should our invoices be addressed to (Redwood Inference, Inc. / US or Redwood Inference EU Ltd)?
2) What tax / VAT evidence do you require from a UK-registered supplier to apply reverse-charge (if applicable) — we can provide our UK VAT certificate and a sample invoice, but we want to avoid any rejections at PO/payment time.

Can you confirm the documents and sample invoice fields we should submit? Also let us know if Redwood requires a fiscal representative for non-EU vendors (we are UK based).

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and the early heads-up. Short answer up front: for UK suppliers we typically route invoices to Redwood Inference EU Ltd when the service is consumed by our EU entity; if the contract is with the US entity we will route to Redwood Inference, Inc.

What we need from you to complete vendor setup and avoid invoice rejections:
- Company legal name, VAT registration number, and a copy of the VAT registration certificate (PDF).
- A sample invoice that includes: supplier VAT number, invoice date, description of services, total excl. VAT, VAT amount (zero if reverse-charge applies) and the PO number once we issue it.
- Bank details (IBAN + SWIFT) on vendor letterhead.
- Completed vendor tax residency self-attestation (attached).

I've attached: vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf (short form) and entity-to-po-mapping.csv (shows which business unit owns POs for common countries). Please: attach the VAT cert and sample invoice in reply, and indicate which Redwood legal entity the contract references. If you expect to be paid by Redwood EU Ltd, we'll raise PO to that entity and record reverse-charge info on the PO.

We aim to complete setup within 3 business days after we receive all docs. If you need an example invoice template, let me know and I'll send one.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
